title: Homilies on Genesis, Homily 12
blurb: Origen’s Homily 12 on Genesis (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–5.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homily 12 on Genesis — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Heine FOTC 71 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homily 12 §§1–5 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VI (GCS 29, 1920), Rufinus’s Latin of Homily 12. Heine FOTC 71 was not used as wording. This page is Homily 12 §§1–5 (closeout).
